sn54.4:1.1: bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ||
sn54.4:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4--10.
sn54.4:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā nisīdati- osato passati || vitthāro ||
sn54.4:1.5: paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || 11.
sn54.4:1.6: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 12.
sn54.4:1.7: Evam bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatiyā evam bahulīkatāya dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ||
sn54.4:1.8: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā ti || || 3.
